o_b_comparator_note: Where scientifically meaningful, recovery relative to O_B (the implemented clairvoyant comparator) may also be reported. O_B must always be described only as the implemented clairvoyant comparator; it is never called the proven optimum O*, and O_B=O* is never inferred. If included, O_B is recorded as a secondary comparator only and never affects policy selection, because no policy selection exists in R2-11 (the policy is already frozen).

primary_metric.aggregation_rule: Equal-weight arithmetic mean across the 12 fresh R2-11 evaluation instances. Never weighted by token count.
primary_metric.paired_delta_definition: delta_i(M) = PredictedProtectPolicy_i(M) - B_selected_i(M), per fresh evaluation instance i and budget M. delta < 0 means predictive retention is better.

secondary_metrics: budget_violations (must be zero for every cell; non-zero is a correctness failure, not a scientific result)
per_category_aggregate (coding / reasoning / summarization / instruction, 3 instances each)
secondary_budget_aggregate (1.5 GiB and 8 GiB, equal-weight mean delta)
